master.title: Knowledge, Context and Agentic Engineering for Knowledge Work
master.description: The full master corpus: LLM fundamentals, prompt, context, knowledge and agentic engineering, Promptotyping, verification. Every workshop below is a documented specialisation.

workshops.title: Introductory Workshop on LLMs and Prompt Engineering & Digital Editions Track
workshops.event: Summer School Large Language Models in Digital Humanities Research, Cologne
workshops.audience: digital humanities researchers working on edition and corpus projects, with heterogeneous prior LLM experience
workshops.focus: four-day English school unit covering all five modules, from LLM fundamentals through two prompt-engineering levels to AI engineering and agents, plus a digital editions track building TEI-based editions from participants' own sources

workshops.title: Promptotyping Pre-Workshop
workshops.audience: participants of the following full-day Promptotyping workshop, mixed technical prerequisites
workshops.focus: ninety-minute German preparation unit with the Promptotyping method core, the context documents and the toolchain setup ahead of the practice day

workshops.title: Digitale Edition und Künstliche Intelligenz
workshops.audience: researchers from editions projects across German studies, history, papyrology, Romance studies and Indology
workshops.focus: Promptotyping for digital scholarly editions, from LLM fundamentals through prompt engineering to TEI-XML generation, with two hands-on units on participant material

workshops.title: Grundlagen Generativer KI und Prompt Engineering
workshops.audience: university staff in an institutional AI-competence programme
workshops.focus: German LLM fundamentals and prompt engineering, EU AI Act block with a knowledge-document hands-on

workshops.title: Promptotyping und Generative AI
workshops.audience: participants without LLM or programming background
workshops.focus: compact introduction, hands-on with low prerequisites

workshops.title: Knowledge, Context and Agentic Engineering for Research Data Workflows & Digital Editions
workshops.event: CLARIAH-AT Summer School 2026: Machine Learning for Digital Scholarly Editions
workshops.focus: research data workflows, digital scholarly editions, Zweig hands-on

workshops.title: HEDIT KI-Workshop 2026
workshops.audience: researchers from the editions projects of the research centre
workshops.focus: agentic engineering for digital scholarly editions, with knowledge and context engineering on day 1 and a two-part Promptotyping workshop on participant material on day 2

workshops.title: Knowledge, Context und Agentic Engineering für die Forschung
workshops.audience: students and early-career researchers in medieval studies
workshops.focus: one-day Claude Code workshop, from LLM and agent fundamentals to a medieval charter mini-edition, handwriting recognition through TEI to a small static edition

workshops.title: Generative KI für Datenaufbereitung, Datenmigration und die Pflege von Interfaces
workshops.event: Göttinger Digitale Akademie, Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen
workshops.audience: staff of academy research projects and library guests
workshops.focus: hybrid half-day on agent-supported research data preparation and migration and on semi-automated maintenance of interfaces and endpoints, with three project case studies and a hands-on on participant material

workshops.title: Agentic-Engineering-Workshop
workshops.audience: professionals from companies and institutions across disciplines
workshops.focus: extended two-day variant for knowledge work beyond academia

workshops.title: VetMed Winter School
workshops.focus: five-day extended derivation of the full master, follow-up format to the VetMedAI programme
